label: X.509 certificate authentication
type: authenticating a client or node by presenting an X.509 certificate validated against a trust store, rather than by username and password.
note: The bridge between the identity half and the crypto half of this round's security batch: it is an auth-mechanism whose machinery is the cert:* family, and cert:trust-store verifiesIdentityOf cert:client-certificate is the same fact stated from the crypto side.
